2026-09-23.patch_summary: This patch refactors the preparation of allocation flags in the Linux kernel's page allocator. It moves the setup of ALLOC_NOLOCK and its associated watermark into a new function called prepare_alloc_flags(), which is then called from both alloc_frozen_pages_noprof() and alloc_pages_bulk_noprof(). The bulk allocator continues to use ALLOC_DEFAULT. This change does not alter the functionality of the code, but rather simplifies it by reducing duplication.
